nodeMajorWhy: nodeMajor is the DETERMINISM PIN (world-fill Plan C, R5): the Node major that runs the map tooling and the byte gates, and therefore the one .github/workflows/ci.yml sets up. runtimeNodeMajor is a DIFFERENT number for a different job — the game-server deployment image in colyseus-server/Dockerfile, which has been node:22-alpine since release 1.2 and never runs mapforge. The plan asserted the two were one number and that ci.yml:33's 18 'matches colyseus-server/Dockerfile'; the tree says otherwise, so both are recorded here and scripts/tests/node-pin.test.mjs joins each to its own consumer. Determinism is a version-pinned contract, not a portability claim.
